codeReview.summary: Reviewed the worker transcript skeleton, handoff, commit b752c95, and the surrounding refresh/search state flow in app.js plus the new Playwright coverage. The fix addresses the regression by flushing pending debounced search input into explicit filter state before refresh fetches and re-renders, which preserves coherent narrowed results on immediate refresh without violating the dashboard’s single-page/state-derivation architecture. The added browser test reproduces the exact pre-debounce race and verifies the preserved search value, filter badge, summary total, and visible rows.

summary: Pass. The implementation satisfies the feature intent: immediate refresh after typing search now preserves the typed term and coherent narrowed state, and the added regression test exercises the previously failing debounce race.
